name: bsa-full
description: Business/Systems Analysis plugin family: 32 skills for evidence-bound claim-layer authoring, anti-hallucination audits, sidecar-assisted diagrams (C4 + BPMN + DBML), H1-H4 handoff packaging, Phase-3 dev-handoff (NFRs / stories / test scenarios / traceability matrix / backlog-bridge to Jira / Linear / generic / GitHub Projects v2 with optional live-API mode), Stage 6 contract exporters (OpenAPI 3.1 / AsyncAPI 3.0 / proto3 with anchor-traceability), plus an operator-side static-HTML dashboard. Directly consumed by Claude Code.

canonPolicyVersion._comment: Custom field — Claude Code preserves unknown top-level fields. Recomputed manually via scripts/compute_canon_hash.py after any POLICY_GLOBS edit; tests/test_plugin_manifest.py::test_manifest_canon_hash_matches_current_script_output fails locally on any drift between this value and the live script output.
